Class CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>

java.lang.Object
io.parsley.CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>
Type Parameters:
KIn - the input key type
VIn - the input value type
KOut - the forwarded key type
VOut - the forwarded value type
Enclosing class:
CausalProcessors
public static final class CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> extends Object
Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier. A serde pair is required (via serdes(Serde, Serde) or serdesByTopic(Function, Function)); the violation handler, store namespace, and frontier listener are optional; a dead-letter sink is required exactly when the policy is a dead-letter policy.

    • storeName

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> storeName(String storeName)
      Sets the state-store namespace (default "parsley"); the frontier store is storeName + "-frontier" and the buffer store storeName + "-buffer". These are persistent, changelog-backed names — keep storeName stable across restarts, and unique per causal processor sharing a topology.
      Parameters:
      storeName - the state-store namespace
      Returns:
      this builder

    • topicUuids

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> topicUuids(Map<String, org.apache.kafka.common.Uuid> topicUuids)
      Provides the Kafka topic UUIDs for the input topics, keyed by topic name. Used as the stable partition identity so that topic deletion and recreation produce different identities. Topics absent from the map fall back to a deterministic name-derived UUID via CausalPosition.deriveUuid(String).
      Parameters:
      topicUuids - topic-name → Kafka UUID map; typically from AdminClient.describeTopics(topics)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public CausalProcessorSupplier<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> build()
      Builds the CausalProcessorSupplier.
      Returns:
      a decorated supplier ready for stream(...).process(...)
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no serde pair was set
      IllegalArgumentException - if any violation type uses CausalViolationAction.DEAD_LETTER and no sink was set, or a sink was set but no violation type uses CausalViolationAction.DEAD_LETTER
